mentions.name: Personal Hugo blog
mentions.description: A personal blog built with Hugo that generates minimal "suckless" static pages. It is intended as a private record of the author's thoughts accumulated from years of working on AI, kept for personal memory-keeping and tracking rather than public readership.
mentions.problem: Wanted a place to record and keep track of years of accumulated thoughts from working on AI.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am finally making my own blog. I have been only planning for ages. I found that I had a lot to say for the past years working on AI, and I want to record them somewhere. I do not expect a lot of visitors or at all in fact. The blog is going to be just for me to remember stuffs and to keep track of them.
